data.task_title: Create Artemis self-demo with Chart.js visualization

features.title: Chart.js Visualizations
features.description: Implement data visualizations using Chart.js for various metrics and stages.
acceptance_criteria: Pipeline metrics are visualized using an 8-stage pipeline chart.
Cost tracking and success rates are displayed using appropriate chart types.
Real-time dashboard includes line, bar, area, and pie charts.

features.title: Content Integration
features.description: Integrate specific content sections to showcase Artemis features and metrics.
acceptance_criteria: HERO section introduces Artemis as an Autonomous AI Development System.
FEATURES section includes cost tracking, sandboxing, and learning metrics.
RESULTS section displays real metrics from recent runs.

features.title: HTML Presentation Setup
features.description: Create a standalone HTML file for the Artemis demo with embedded CSS, JavaScript, and Chart.js.
acceptance_criteria: HTML file is standalone with no external dependencies.
CSS and JavaScript are embedded within the HTML file.
Chart.js library is correctly integrated for data visualization.

features.title: Interactive Elements
features.description: Enhance the demo with interactive elements and animations using Chart.js.
acceptance_criteria: Charts include animations for data transitions.
Interactive elements respond to user inputs.
User interactions enhance the understanding of the data.

features.title: Auto-Advance and Navigation
features.description: Implement auto-advance functionality for slides with navigation controls.
acceptance_criteria: Slides auto-advance after a set duration.
Users can manually navigate between slides using controls.
Navigation controls are intuitive and responsive.

features.title: Professional Design
features.description: Design the presentation with a professional gradient background and smooth transitions.
acceptance_criteria: Background uses a professional gradient design.
Transitions between slides are smooth and visually appealing.
Overall design is consistent and professional.
